version: Flutter 3.47.8 (framework 737ba8f885, engine cf636b1dfb), Dart 3.13.7, package:ffi 2.2.0, Impeller-GLES
notes: Flutter Dart-AOT release, Linux GTK3 embedder, renderer: Impeller (OpenGL ES backend, default), GL = Mesa (llvmpipe under Xvfb). frame_ms = interval between consecutive FrameTiming rasterFinish timestamps (SchedulerBinding.addTimingsCallback; raster thread finished the frame and handed it to the GTK GL compositor; latest public post-render signal, not an X11 present timestamp). Only frames the engine rasterized are counted (Flutter produces no frame when nothing is dirty; every animated frame changes content). Cadence cap ~60 Hz: the Linux embedder registers no vsync callback, so the engine uses its fallback vsync waiter with a fixed 1/60 s tick (engine source shell/common/vsync_waiter_fallback.cc); no public option to disable it, kept. gc = null: Dart exposes no GC counters in AOT release. Warm-up 2 s; script time frozen at 0 during warm-up. canvas (BENCH_CANVAS_MODE=direct): per shape drawRect/drawCircle/drawRRect with its own gradient Paint, MaskFilter.blur(sigma 4) shadow at (2,2) for 1 in 10, clipRRect 1000x600 r16, graph drawRawPoints(polygon) 10000 pts stroke 1 px.
